layout: float32 LE x4 per tree: dlon_deg, dlat_deg (from origin), ground_orthometric_m, tree_height_m
status: VISUAL APPROXIMATION - not surveyed tree positions
method: Jittered 10 m grid. A grid point becomes a tree when it lies in an OSM natural=wood/landuse=forest polygon, or where canopy height (Copernicus DSM - FABDEM DTM) >= 3.5 m; excluded within 5 m of buildings (22 m for canopy-derived points), on roads, pitches, parking and water. Heights are scaled from canopy height and randomised for display.
